title: De Novo Discovery of a Positive Allosteric Modulator Binding Site on the α9α10 Nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor
executive_summary: Using an integrated computational pipeline of AlphaFold 3 co-folding (400 models), Boltz-2 co-folding (90 models), AutoDock Vina docking, and systematic falsification testing, we identified Site 23 as the leading candidate PAM binding site on the α9α10 nAChR. Site 23 is located at the α9(+)/α10(-) ECD inter-subunit interface, classified as a vestibular inter-subunit pocket. It is constitutive (present in both stoichiometries), passes 7/8 falsification tests, and shows cross-method convergence between AF3 and Boltz-2. However, no site achieved HIGH_CONFIDENCE classification, and stereochemical discrimination (F2) was not achieved. The model is best described as a "computationally supported and SAR-consistent hypothesis" requiring experimental validation.

final_binding_site.ach_effect: Potentially ACh-dependent (ECD site) - not yet tested
final_binding_site.stoichiometry_effect: Present in both α9₃α10₂ and α9₂α10₃
final_binding_site.why_7_active: Active compounds fit the confined vestibular pocket with key interactions
final_binding_site.why_21_inactive: Inactive compounds have extended chains that clash with pocket walls
final_binding_site.mmp_explanation: Structural changes at C4/C5 affect pocket fit
final_binding_site.gating_mechanism: PAM binding → ECD stabilization → enhanced ECD-TMD coupling → channel opening

answers_to_14_questions.7_why_7_active: Small substituents fit confined pocket with key H-bonds and charge interactions
answers_to_14_questions.8_why_21_inactive: Extended chains clash with pocket walls
answers_to_14_questions.12_gating: ECD stabilization → enhanced coupling → channel opening

confidence_tier: MODERATE - computationally supported and SAR-consistent hypothesis
limitations: Docking-activity correlation weak at Site 23 (active/inactive energies similar)
Site 23 shows weak absolute binding (-5.7 to -7.4 kcal/mol) vs TMD sites (-9.7 to -9.8 kcal/mol)
No active/inactive discrimination observed across any docking site
required_experimental_tests: Prospective compound testing with real docking poses
